title: ACA s. 34 — Application for setting aside arbitral award (Patent Illegality & Public Policy) (ACA s. 34)

content.overview: Section 34 provides the statutory grounds on which a court may set aside a domestic or applicable arbitral award. The grounds include incapacity, invalid arbitration agreement, procedural violations, excess of submission, improper composition/procedure, non-arbitrability and conflict with public policy, with the statutory distinctions for international commercial awards and the additional patent-illegality ground applicable to domestic awards.
